title: Monotonicity of computation time
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, $O$ an oracle language, and $x,w$ words. If $M$ halts with output $w$ after $t$ steps relative to $O$, then it also halts with output $w$ after $t'$ steps relative to $O$ for every $t'\ge t$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of ordinary work tapes
A state type and symbol type
A time $t$ at which $M$ halts with output $w$
